Save candidate-specific aliases/cap/payload identity and install metadata/emit selection only for the returned candidate; a full choice clears stale adaptive state. Ordinary full repair admission and a nonempty state-preserving baseline remain required. Only actual initial output cap shrinks; unknown draft reserve uses that cap and repair keeps 4096. Exact wire identity, budgets, length rejection, bounded repair, source obligations and replay restrictions remain unchanged.
